text:
Priya: heads-up: i'm drafting a lightweight "golden-run" guideline for onboarding. main goal: reproducible perf checks + a clearly versioned bench config. want quick alignment before i open an RFC.
Owen: sounds useful. are we talking deterministic outputs or deterministic perf runs?
Priya: both, but split. golden-run = small deterministic workload (seeded prompts + deterministic RNG) that produces a compact artifact (golden outputs + perf trace). it isn't the full acceptance bench.
Marta: how do we keep golden-run small but meaningful? teams will cheat by picking trivial prompts.
Priya: propose a curated seedset per model family (lm, instruct, chat) maintained by bench-team. each seed gets a tag: short/long/multi-turn. registry enforces that at least one long and one multi-turn seed are included.
Ken: OK. what about variability across hardware? golden-run should run on a reference host flavor.
Samir: bench-team already has a "reference image" for each backend (e.g., gtx-4090-rtx, a100-80g). golden-run manifest must include bench_host_tag so ingestion can map to the right CI queue.
Priya: yes. include bench_host_tag, bench_suite_version, and bench_config_checksum in the golden-run blob. runtime will record a bench_signature on first successful run.
Owen: i worry about drift: models improved via quantization or kernel changes will naturally change outputs. do we want strict equality?
Marta: strict equals will be annoying. make golden-run comparisons tolerant: hash of tokenized IDs + normalized perf metrics; compare with a tolerant threshold for p50/p95 and a token-level edit-distance threshold for outputs.
Ken: agree. add a regression level: warn / fail / block. by default, golden-run warns on minor divergence, fails on 'semantic_regressions' > threshold, blocks only if bench_suite_version mismatches by major version.
Samir: also need a compatibility matrix document attached to model registry entry: lists runtime capabilities (fused_attention, kv_layouts, aten_ops_set, int8-friendly). registry computed field can be one of: compatible, partially_compatible, incompatible.
Priya: nice. ingestion pipeline should run a "matrix-probe" that runs tiny capability checks and annotates model entry. probes are small: < 30s.
Owen: automation idea: if probe returns partially_compatible, registry can auto-suggest transforms (e.g., remap kv_layout, use bf16 quant) and tag the model with suggested adaptors.
Marta: keep a human-in-the-loop for dedicated promotion. automation ok for hosted best-effort.
Ken: actionables?
Priya: 1) i'll PR golden-run guideline + sample manifest schema: fields: seeds[], bench_host_tag, bench_suite_version, bench_config_checksum, comparison_policy {levels}, provenance. 2) Samir to draft matrix-probe CLI + probe list. 3) Owen to prototype tolerant comparator lib (token-id diff + perf thresholds).
Samir: i'll also add a small capability-probe runner to the ingest CI job and a registry flag `compatibility_status`.
Owen: for comparator, let's expose a `--tolerance` flag and default to token-id-levenshtein <= 3% and p50 within 10%. we can tweak.
Marta: add migration for existing models: run golden-run with auto-generated seedset and annotate results; do not block existing traffic.
Priya: decision summary: - introduce golden-run artifact (small, deterministic) + comparator with three outcome levels. - introduce compatibility matrix + probe at ingest. - staged enforcement: warn for hosted, block for dedicated/private when major version mismatches.
Ken: one more ask: include a `debug_trace` toggle in golden-run for bench-team so we can capture kv-cache traces when needed.
Priya: fair. the debug_trace will be off in normal CI but available on demand.
InfraBot: CI update: ingest pipeline job `golden-probe` added to presubmit (job 121478). job runs in ~60s on reference image.
Samir: small nit: add `max_wall_time` to golden manifest so long-running models can't hang CI.
Priya: will add.
Owen: ack. i'll start the tolerant comparator PR tomorrow.
Marta: ack, i'll add migration steps to the release notes.
Ken: ack.
Priya: thanks everyone. i'll open RFC with examples + a tiny reference runner (bash + curl) and a sample golden blob. snippet i'll include in PR:
Priya: ```bash
# run golden probe locally
curl -X POST "$REGISTRY/api/v1/models/$MODELID/golden-run?host=$BENCH_HOST" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -F 'golden_blob=@golden.json'
# returns {"compatibility_status":"partially_compatible","bench_signature":"abc123"}
```
Priya: will follow-up in RFC, close thread here. thanks :pray:
